ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends our access but gives us no exit help or data-retrieval right (and 16.5 defers Customer Data to a Section 11 that does not exist), so we have added 10.3: up to six months' transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. The 30-day clock runs from expiry or termination rather than from a request so the obligation is self-executing.
